verdict.rationale: Adyen documents low-friction paths that could suggest fast acceptance — no setup/monthly fees, payment links, and a single Checkout sessions API call (adyen-docs-23, adyen-docs-24, adyen-docs-1) — but concrete hands-on community evidence contradicts a same-day founder signup: Adyen is reported to refuse small clients outright ('under the million', adyen-comm-1), require lengthy underwriting/minimum volumes that keep early-stage startups away (adyen-comm-11), and demand hundreds of integration hours even for experienced teams (adyen-comm-9), plus large reserve requirements for subscription models (adyen-comm-6). missing for 10: evidence of an actual fast/self-serve signup-to-first-payment flow for a brand-new small founder, and any first-party or community confirmation that onboarding can complete within a day rather than requiring lengthy KYC/underwriting.
